integrity: The analytic diagonalization proves the full infinite-dimensional assertion; the accompanying exact-arithmetic checker is corroborative rather than an independent proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the quadratic anti-analytic symbol on standard radial beta weights, not arbitrary symbols or all monomial degrees. Some historical operator-norm literature could not be inspected in full.
title: Exact weight-driven mode staircase for the quadratic Bergman Hankel operator
